<thought>The previous search returned no results, likely because the criteria were too restrictive. I will broaden the search by specifying the bonds formed and broken, while keeping the functional groups broken (ketone and C‑C double bond). This should retrieve templates that describe the carbonyl‑ene transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=C", "C=O"],
    "limit": 10
}
